title: Northern Juan de Fuca-style Layered P-Wave Refraction Inversion
summary: Infer a three-layer oceanic P-wave velocity/thickness model from active-source travel-time picks, then validate predictions and physical invariants on hidden offsets.
taskPrompt: Read input/problem_spec.md and input/picks.csv. Perform the weighted straight-line branch fits and layered refraction inversion described there. Produce model.json, predictions.csv, inversion_trace.csv, and diagnostics.json under output/. Units are km, km/s, and s; no network is available.
agentMustDo: Fit each labelled travel-time branch with uncertainty weights and convert slopes/intercepts to layer velocities and thicknesses.
Recompute visible predictions and residuals using the layered ray formulas.
Record a non-increasing multi-iteration inversion trace and report RMS, reduced chi-square, and invariant status.
Match the exact schemas and keep all deliverables inside output/.

inputFiles.name: problem_spec.md
inputFiles.description: Equations, units, workflow, and output contract.

referenceFiles.name: reference.json
referenceFiles.description: Evaluator-only oracle model and hidden-prediction targets.

evaluation: Hard schema/path gates return 0. Weighted score: model recovery 0.35, visible predictions 0.20, independently recomputed hidden holdout predictions 0.25, iterative trace 0.10, invariant/diagnostics 0.10. Hidden prediction error above 10 ms caps the score below 0.60.
